name: Digital Mudir Dokan
description: Custom WordPress + WooCommerce theme for a Bangladeshi grocery store — shop, cart, checkout and account flows built for local delivery and COD.
detail: WooCommerce-first theme I wrote from scratch with Tailwind CSS and semantic HTML5. Customizer-driven hero slider, homepage product grids, promo banners, FAQ and WhatsApp CTA; tailored templates for archive, single product, cart and checkout; JSON-LD for Organization, Product and Breadcrumb. Live on digitalmudirdokan.com.

stack.frontend: PHP templates · Tailwind CSS · Vanilla JS
stack.dashboard: WP Admin · Theme options · Customizer panels
